title: Open-sourcing our Node.js, MongoDB-backed background jobs processor
summary: Over the past two years, we've used our MongoDB-backed library to run billions of Node.js background jobs. It continues to run ~40M jobs per week (and growing) with throughput topping around 850 jobs/second. We open-sourced the library for others to use.
